## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the student collaboration or peer-learning problem. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Relevance to Student Builders & Hackathons
How does this feature help students in the room or on campus connect more effectively?

## Architectural Guardrail Checklist
- [ ] Uses strictly the open-weight model `gemma-4-31b-it` (no closed models).
- [ ] Preserves fact-grounding (AI does not invent credentials).
- [ ] Protects user privacy and respects phone number confidentiality.
- [ ] Maintains GitHub Primer design aesthetics and mobile responsiveness.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
